pages.text: $(thing)Turing Patterns$()$(br2)A zebra's stripes, a leopard's spots, the ridges of a fingerprint: the same two-chemical sum at different spacings. Unlocks cheaper Turing Morphogens and Morphogenic Serum.

$(thing)Insight$(): 110$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Reaction and Diffusion, Morphogenesis.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Pattern Template.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A tail of radius R has bands laid round it at a spacing w. Write how many bands N fit along its circumference.
